create.name: Tammy Billups
create.bio:
Tammy Billups is a certified Interface Therapist, author and intuitive energy practitioner whose work centres on the bond between animals and the people they live with. After training in Interface Therapy, a bioenergetic approach, she began working with animals as well as people, and over some twenty-five years developed her own method, Animal-Human Tandem Healing, in which an animal and its person are worked with together, remotely. Her view is that animals and humans meet through soul contracts and often mirror each other's emotional patterns.

She has written four books with Bear & Company: Soul Healing with Our Animal Companions (2018), Animal Soul Contracts (2020), Animal Wayshowers (2022) and Your Animal, Your Soul Mirror (2025). She teaches through self-paced courses on The Shift Network on soul contracts and emotional wound patterns between animals and their people, runs a practitioner certification in her method, and shares free guided meditations on self-compassion, grounding and connecting with an animal's spirit on her YouTube channel. She works with clients by Zoom.

books.title: Animal Soul Contracts: Sacred Agreements for Shared Evolution
books.author: Tammy Billups
books.description: Tammy Billups explores the idea that animals and people come together through soul agreements made for their shared growth. Drawing on stories from her practice, she describes the different kinds of contracts and how understanding them can change the way we see our animal companions.

books.title: Your Animal ― Your Soul Mirror: Healing the Emotional Wounds of Animals and Their People
books.author: Tammy Billups
books.description: Her 2025 book on soul mirroring, the idea that animals reflect the emotional patterns of the people they live with. It sets out the emotional wound patterns she has observed and offers practices for animal and person to work through them together. Foreword by Penelope Smith.

books.title: Animal Wayshowers: The Lightworkers Ushering In 5D Consciousness
books.author: Tammy Billups
books.description: Tammy Billups presents animals as spiritual guides helping people move towards a more awakened, heart-centred consciousness. She looks at the roles different animals play in the lives of their people and in the collective shift. Foreword by Linda Star Wolf.

books.title: Soul Healing with Our Animal Companions: The Hidden Keys to a Deeper Animal-Human Connection
books.author: Tammy Billups
books.description: Her first book introduces the soul bond between people and their animals and the idea that animals take on and mirror their people's emotional patterns. It includes stories from her sessions and practices for deepening the connection.

courses.title: Honoring Your Soul Contracts With Animal Companions
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced course on why people and their animals choose each other and the soul agreements behind the relationship. It uses teachings, real-life examples and guided meditative journeys, including reincarnation and pre-birth planning.

courses.title: The Emotional Wound Soul Contract Between Animals & Their People
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced course on the emotional patterns animals and their people share, based on the five wound patterns Tammy describes. Weekly practices help both partners move towards more love and peace together.

Two of the most-viewed meditations are titled 'Healing Abandonment' and 'Healing Betrayal'; kept as emotional themes rather than medical conditions, but a human should confirm. 'I Am Safe ~ Healing Terror From Trauma/Abuse' was left out.
Her own sessions page makes strong health claims for animals (immune system, pain, recovery from surgery); sessions are not listed and nothing from that page is used, but the website_url leads there.
Her method's name, Animal-Human Tandem Healing, is mentioned in the bio as a name only; the certification page says 'physical and emotional issues ease or resolve'.
Amazon lists Linda Star Wolf (Animal Wayshowers) and Penelope Smith (Your Animal ― Your Soul Mirror) as foreword writers, not co-authors.
